title: automated immutable upgrade manifests with helm provenance and TUF snapshotting
author: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Private/on-prem upgrades require a single, immutable snapshot of all artifacts (helm charts, installer images, terraform modules, SBOMs) so air-gapped clusters can perform deterministic upgrades and safe rollbacks. Today we rely on ad-hoc lists and ad-hoc signing which led to a rollback incident where a chart digest drifted between regions. Motivation: provide a reproducible, signed upgrade manifest that ties together all release artifacts and can be consumed by the installer and the TUF-backed artifact mirror used in air-gapped installs. What this PR does: 1) Adds a release manifest indexer pipeline job that collects build artifacts (image digests, Helm chart tarballs + .prov provenance files, terraform module lockfiles, and SBOM links), computes content-addressable digests, and produces a single compressed manifest bundle (upgrade-manifest-<version>.tar.gz). 2) Integrates cosign signing/verifying of both the bundle and individual entries, and stores cosign payloads alongside the manifest (enables key rotation audit). 3) Emits a TUF snapshot update: the pipeline stages the manifest into the TUF repo, creates consistent snapshot and timestamp metadata, and publishes the TUF metadata alongside the bundle for the air-gapped mirror. 4) Generates an upgrade-plan JSON (deterministic) that the installer uses for canary/cutover/rollback. The plan enumerates ordered steps with pre-check hashes and reversible actions. 5) Adds an installer-side manifest validator and rollback-checker that will verify signatures, validate chart provenance, and synthesize a rollback plan when a step fails. 6) CI: new integration tests that run an air-gapped simulation (local registry + mock TUF server) validating that the manifest can be applied and, on simulated failure, the rollback path is accepted. 7) Docs: docs/release/upgrade-manifests.md with consumption guidance for operator and platform teams. Checklist: - [x] manifest indexer job implementation and pipeline yaml - [x] cosign signing + verify step - [x] TUF snapshotting integration and publish stage - [x] installer manifest validator + rollback-checker - [x] helm chart provenance consumption (.prov files) - [x] terraform module lock digest collection - [x] integration tests for air-gapped apply/rollback - [x] documentation and runbook notes Rollout: merged to main and gated behind the existing release pipeline. The indexer job is feature-flagged for the next scheduled private-installer release so we can test mirrors without impacting hosted flows. Notes on security and keys: cosign keys are read from the secure KMS path referenced by the pipeline; TUF root delegation is unchanged but the snapshot/timestamp keys are managed in CI and rotated per the existing rotation playbook. Backwards compatibility: installers that do not yet opt-in will continue to accept the old manifest path; once operator teams switch to the new TUF-backed manifest endpoint they must point the installer config at the new index URL. Migration docs included. Why different from previous work: prior PRs focused on signing individual artifacts or rotating metadata; this change binds together the entire upgrade surface (helm + terraform + images + sbom + terraform locks) into a single signed, TUF-published manifest and adds concrete rollback automation consumed by the installer.

review_conversation: Arjun Patel: Can we avoid bundling full SBOMs into the manifest tarball? For air-gapped clusters we prefer SBOM references (S3 path) instead of embedding large files.
Maya Chen (author): Good point — indexer now stores SBOM references and a small SBOM index; full SBOMs remain in the release bucket. Updated pipeline accordingly.
Lina Gomez: Please add a unit test for the manifest validator when a chart digest doesn't match the .prov file.
Maya Chen: Added a failing-case unit test in installer/manifest/test_validator.go and a corresponding fixture.
Evan Park: CI integration flaked once on airgapped integration test (network timeout). Reran and all green. Also left a minor nits comment about log verbosity.
Arjun Patel: Approve after fixups. Leaving an approval comment.
Lina Gomez: Approved. Adding suggestion to follow up with runbook for emergency key rollforward.
release_notes:
- Introduce immutable upgrade manifest bundles for private installer releases.
- Add cosign-signed manifests and per-artifact provenance links.
- Publish manifest via TUF snapshot + timestamp for atomic, auditable air-gapped mirrors.
- Installer gains manifest validator and rollback-checker to automate safe rollbacks.
summary_line: pipeline + tooling to generate a single signed, TUF-published upgrade manifest that ties helm charts, images, terraform locks and SBOM refs together and enables deterministic rollbacks
notes_for_ops: Feature-flagged: to enable, set installer.config.release_manifest.index_url to the new TUF endpoint and ensure KMS keys are available in CI. Operators should run the included mirror-validation script (tools/tuf/README.md) when seeding air-gapped mirrors.
